privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Intro: HeyBub collects information you provide directly when using our baby tracking app:
privacy.section1Item1Desc: Email address and name via Google Sign-In
privacy.section1Item2Desc: Baby names, birth dates, and gender
privacy.section1Item3Desc: Feeding, diaper, sleep, and other tracking data you log
privacy.section1Item4Desc: Doctor visits, vaccinations, medications, and growth data
privacy.section2Intro: We use your data solely to:
privacy.section2Item2: Display your logged activities and summaries
privacy.section2Item3: Enable sharing with caregivers you authorize
privacy.section2Item4: Improve app functionality and fix bugs
privacy.section2NoSell: We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.section3Intro: Your data is stored securely using:
privacy.section3Item1: AWS cloud infrastructure with encryption at rest
privacy.section3Item2: Secure authentication via Supabase Auth and Google OAuth
privacy.section3Item3: HTTPS encryption for all data transmission
privacy.section4Intro: We only share your data when:
privacy.section4Item1: You explicitly share a baby profile with another caregiver
privacy.section4Item2: Required by law or legal process
privacy.section5Item1: Access all your stored data through the app
privacy.section5Item2: Delete your baby profiles and associated data
privacy.section5Item3: Revoke sharing access at any time
privacy.section5Item4: Request account deletion by contacting us
privacy.section6Text: This app is designed for parents/caregivers to track infant care. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.
privacy.section7Text: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify users of significant changes through the app.
privacy.section8Text: For privacy questions or concerns, contact us at:
